# artifactkeeper_format_handler (Resource)

Enables or disables a built-in format handler (e.g. `docker`, `npm`, `maven`). The handler itself is seeded by the backend; this resource manages only whether it is enabled. Destroying the resource re-enables the handler (the backend default).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Container images go through Harbor, so disable the OCI/Docker format here.
resource "artifactkeeper_format_handler" "docker" {
  format_key = "docker"
  enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the format handler is enabled. Set to `false` to block creating/serving repositories of this format.
- `format_key` (String) Format handler key, e.g. `docker`, `npm`, `pypi`, `rpm`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Handler description, if any.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable handler name.
- `handler_type` (String) Handler type (e.g. `core`, `plugin`).
- `id` (String) Format handler UUID.
- `priority` (Number) Resolution priority.
- `repository_count` (Number) Number of repositories using this format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Format handlers are addressed by their format key.
terraform import artifactkeeper_format_handler.docker docker
```
